title: BDIQA: A New Dataset for Video Question Answering to Explore Cognitive Reasoning through Theory of Mind
reasoning: The paper focuses on building a benchmark (BDIQA) to explore cognitive reasoning capabilities of VideoQA models based on the psychological concept of Theory of Mind (beliefs, desires, intentions). While it touches upon human value alignment as a general concept, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component.
